definitions.processing_backlog: Valid Q(t) observations; ownership changes and missing observations break the line.
definitions.throughput: Distinct first completions per nonoverlapping 30-second interval; includes warm-up messages completed during evaluation.
definitions.window_p99: Nearest-rank p99 of creation-to-completion latency for evaluation messages completed in each nonoverlapping 30-second interval.
definitions.growth: Mean processing-backlog growth over 15 valid two-second intervals.
definitions.skew: Mean lag skew over 15 consecutive valid observations.
definitions.persistent_hot: Number of persistently hot partitions from the existing lag-based calculation.
definitions.resources: CPU and RSS totals only where all started consumer processes have fresh observations; no missing component is replaced with zero.
definitions.scope: Evaluation only, excluding warm-up and drain. No averaging across trials or deployments.
